name: CrushOn AI
summary: Unfiltered character chat with a very large community library, persistent character memory, and a free tier with unlimited access to designated free models. One of two apps on this desk with a tracked link.
ranking_rationale: First-party pricing page (verified live in a browser) documents unlimited free-model access, a 100-credit free allowance, 8K free memory, voice messages, and a $5.99 monthly Standard plan. Adult text roleplay for 18+ users is in the official FAQ. Ranks high on testable free access, but the app-distribution picture is murky: iOS/Android apps are claimed by the FAQ with no verifiable store listing.

pricing.free_tier: 100 monthly credits + unlimited designated free models, 8K memory

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Verified by selecting Monthly in the live pricing page. 16K-memory models, 4,000 pinned characters per chat, voice features.

plans.name: Standard (annual)
plans.notes: $4.91/mo effective. The site's $4.9/mo headline is annual billing — do not read it as month-to-month.

pricing.notes: Free chat history is deleted after 7 days of inactivity; paid history retained during membership. Annual is promotional and can change.

pros: Unlimited access to designated free models, separate from credits
